**REQUEST FOR QUOTATION (RFQ)**

**Tender Reference:** GEM/2026/B/TEST_CLEAN  
**Procuring Authority:** GAIL India Limited  
**Project Title:** Battery Bank SITC (Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning)

---

Dear Sir/Madam,

We invite you to submit your most competitive quotation for the supply of high-quality battery systems as detailed below. This procurement is part of a critical infrastructure project under GAIL India Limited, and we seek to partner with an established OEM capable of meeting stringent technical and delivery requirements.

---

### **SCOPE OF SUPPLY – BILL OF QUANTITIES (BoQ)**

| **S. No.** | **Item Description** | **Technical Specification** | **Quantity** | **Unit** | **Delivery Location** | **Required By Date** |
|------------|----------------------|----------------------------|--------------|----------|-----------------------|----------------------|
| 1 | 2V 500Ah VRLA Cells | IS 15549 | 100 | Nos | Visakhapatnam | 30-Sep-2026 |

---

### **COMMERCIAL & DELIVERY REQUIREMENTS**

**1. Quotation Validity:** Minimum 90 days from submission date

**2. Pricing Requirements:**
Please provide the following breakdown for each line item:
- Unit Price (INR) – Ex-Works
- Unit Price (INR) – Delivered at Site (Visakhapatnam)
- GST (rate % and amount separately)
- Any other applicable taxes/duties
- Transportation, insurance, and handling charges
- Installation, testing & commissioning charges (if applicable under SITC scope)

**3. Delivery Timeline:**
- Maximum acceptable delivery period: **60 days** from date of Purchase Order
- Please confirm your committed delivery schedule

**4. Payment Terms:**
- **100% against receipt and acceptance** at site
- Please confirm acceptance or propose alternative terms with justification

**5. Lead Time:**
- Specify manufacturing lead time (in weeks/days)
- Specify transportation and installation duration separately

**6. Technical Compliance:**
Please submit the following mandatory documents:
- Technical Compliance Statement for IS 15549 standard
- OEM Authorization Certificate / Dealership Letter
- Product datasheet and technical brochure
- Test certificates and quality assurance documentation
- Manufacturer's warranty terms and conditions
- List of similar supplies to PSUs/Government organizations (if any)

**7. Warranty & After-Sales Support:**
- Comprehensive warranty period and coverage details
- Details of after-sales service support
- Availability of spare parts and technical assistance

---

### **INSTRUCTIONS TO BIDDERS**

1. Quotations must be submitted on your official letterhead with authorized signature and company seal
2. All prices should be quoted in Indian Rupees (INR) only
3. Please clearly indicate whether you are the OEM or an authorized channel partner
4. Partial quotations will not be accepted
5. The Procuring Authority reserves the right to accept or reject any quotation without assigning reasons
6. Submission Deadline: **[Insert Date – typically 10-15 days from issuance]**

---

### **SUBMISSION DETAILS**

Please submit your quotation via email to:

**Email:** [Insert Email Address]  
**Contact Person:** [Insert Name]  
**Phone:** [Insert Contact Number]

For technical clarifications or site visit requests, please contact us at the earliest.

---

We look forward to receiving your competitive and compliant quotation. Should you require any additional information or clarification regarding this RFQ, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Thank you for your cooperation.

**Yours faithfully,**

**[Authorized Signatory Name]**  
**[Designation]**  
Procurement & Supply Chain Specialist  
Volks Energie  
[Contact Details]

---

**For and on behalf of:**  
**GAIL India Limited**  
**Project:** Battery Bank SITC  
**Tender Ref:** GEM/2026/B/TEST_CLEAN
